qsm-usage toon encode.description: Encode a JSON, YAML, or TOML file to TOON; --frontmatter or --table --section pull the data out of Markdown first

args.name: file
args.description: the file to encode

args.name: frontmatter
args.description: encode the YAML frontmatter block of a Markdown file

args.name: table
args.description: encode one pipe table of a Markdown file; needs --section

args.name: section
args.description: the heading the table sits under, matched case-insensitively

qsm-usage toon decode.description: Decode a TOON file back to compact JSON on stdout

args.name: file
args.description: the TOON file to decode

qsm-usage toon size.description: Compare an input against its TOON encoding in characters and estimated tokens, and say which to use

args.name: file
args.description: the file to measure

args.name: frontmatter
args.description: measure the YAML frontmatter block of a Markdown file

args.name: table
args.description: measure one pipe table of a Markdown file; needs --section

args.name: section
args.description: the heading the table sits under, matched case-insensitively

qsm-usage toon wrap.description: Read text on stdin, parse it as JSON, YAML, or TOML, and say whether its TOON encoding is worth using in its place

args.name: stdin
args.description: read the text from standard input; required

qsm-usage filter.description: Ask the command output filter what it makes of a Bash command: the command to run instead, or a denial; nothing when the filter is absent or has nothing to rewrite

args.name: command
args.description: the Bash command about to run

args.name: subagent
args.description: a subagent asked: its git commands are never routed through the filter

qsm-usage doctor.description: Report whether qsm-usage and the command output filter are each usable, with what each one answered

qsm-usage count.description: Count the tokens of files or of standard input, offline by default and exactly with the credential

args.name: files
args.description: the files to count; omit with --stdin

args.name: stdin
args.description: count standard input as well

args.name: total
args.description: print the total even for a single input

args.name: mode
args.description: estimate offline (default), or exact through the provider's tokenizer

args.name: model
args.description: the model whose tokenizer exact mode asks (default claude's current)

qsm-usage drop.description: Record a finding the person dropped, as <topic>:<target>, so a later review does not offer it again

args.name: key
args.description: the finding's topic and target, e.g. unused-extensions:skill pdf-tools

qsm-usage dropped.description: List the findings dropped in earlier reviews, one key per line

qsm-usage report.description: Validate a findings document and render one self-contained HTML report from it

args.name: file
args.description: the findings JSON file to render

args.name: out
args.description: the HTML file to write
